line.a_piknik.text: What a lovely day! Let's have a picnic on the glade, on the other side of the brook.

line.a_most.text: The bridge is far away, over there. Let's make our own little bridge here, from a plank!

line.a_deski.text: Two planks are lying on the grass. We need a long one, so it reaches the other bank.

line.a_ta.text: This one is longer! Look, it reaches all the way there, further than that one.

line.a_wpadla.text: Oh no! The plank didn't reach and fell into the water. It was too short!

line.a_wylowilem.text: Never mind, I fished it out. But how can we tell which plank is longer?

line.a_metoda.text: That plank only lay further out, so it looked longer. To compare length, put the planks side by side from one line.

line.a_przeciagnij.text: Drag both planks to the line, so they start in the same place.

line.a_teraz_widac.text: The one whose end is further from the line is longer. Point to the longer plank.

line.a_ta_krotsza.text: This plank ends sooner, it is shorter. Which one reaches further from the line?

line.a_dluzsza.text: This one is longer! And that one is shorter. Now I can see it.

line.a_siega.text: The long plank reaches the other bank. We have a bridge!

line.b_zimno.text: Brr, it's so windy! My scarf is too short, I can't wrap it around my neck.

line.b_szaliki.text: I have another scarf. Put both from the line and we'll see which one is longer.

line.b_ktory.text: Which scarf is longer? Point to it, and Squirrel will put it on.

line.b_za_krotki.text: That is the short scarf, it won't wrap around. Point to the longer one.

line.b_cieplo.text: The long scarf wraps all around! Now I'm warm.

line.b_wyscig.text: Look, the snails are racing to the flower! Point to a snail to cheer it on.

line.b_meta.text: It's at the finish! Bravo, little snail!

line.b_piknik.text: Everyone got a piece of the long baguette. There was enough for all of us!

line.b_do_domu.text: Yum! This evening we go home. Fox, then I'll give you back your scarf.

line.p_start.text: Let's play long and short! I have five games.

line.p_wstazki.text: The ribbons are lying every which way. Put them from the line to compare them.

line.p_dluzsza_nie.text: This ribbon is shorter. Point to the one that reaches further from the line.

line.p_najkrotsza.text: Three planks start at the line. Point to the shortest plank.

line.p_najkrotsza_nie.text: This plank is longer. We are looking for the one that ends soonest.

line.p_najkrotsza_ok.text: Yes! That is the shortest plank.

line.p_weze.text: I drew two snakes. Point to the longer snake.

line.p_weze_nie.text: This snake is shorter. Which one goes on longer?

line.p_cien_dlugi.text: This is the shadow of the long scarf. Point to that scarf.

line.p_cien_krotki.text: This is the shadow of the short scarf. Point to that scarf.

line.p_cien_nie.text: Look at the shadow again. Is it long or short?

line.p_cien_ok.text: Yes! The shadow fits the scarf.

line.p_lap.text: Ribbons are popping up! Point to the long ribbon before it hides.

line.p_lap_ok.text: Caught! The long ribbon every time.

line.d_wieszaki.text: Let's hang both scarves on the hooks.

line.d_daj.text: Drag each scarf up to the hooks, onto a hook of its own.

line.d_nie_ten.text: The hooks are higher up, on the wall. Drag the scarf onto a hook.

line.d_pasuje.text: Yes, the long scarf is Fox's, and the short one is mine!

line.d_rodzice.text: Compare shoelaces or spaghetti with your parents. Remember: always from one line!

line.a_konce.text: Now look where each plank ends. I'm marking the ends.

line.k_kuchnia.text: And now dinner! The pasta is on the table.

line.k_ja_najdluzszy.text: I want the longest pasta! I'll take this one, it sticks out furthest.

line.k_umowa.text: Fox, that pasta only lies further out, just like the plank at the brook. Let's lay them all from one line.

line.k_najdluzszy.text: Point to the longest pasta, the one for me.

line.k_najdluzszy_nie.text: Look whose end is furthest from the line.

line.k_najdluzszy_nie.sarenka.text: Look whose end is furthest from the line.

line.k_najkrotszy.text: And now point to the shortest pasta, the one for me.

line.k_najkrotszy_nie.text: Look for the one whose end is closest to the line.

line.k_najkrotszy_nie.sarenka.text: Look for the one whose end is closest to the line.

line.k_pomieszajmy.text: I've got an idea! Let's cook the longest and the shortest in one pot. Everyone gets their own!

line.k_pyszne.text: My pasta goes on and on! Yummy!

line.b_mapa.text: Picnic time! But where is our glade? I have a map, let's see which way to go.

line.b_mapa_drogi.text: We are down here, by the meadow, and the glade with the blanket is at the top. Two paths lead there. Both start at the same place.

line.b_mapa_ktora.text: My tummy is rumbling! Let's take the shorter path, then we'll get there sooner. Which path is shorter? Point to it.

line.b_mapa_nie.text: Look at both paths from the very start. Which one reaches the blanket sooner? Point to the shorter one.

line.b_mapa_tak.text: Yes! This path is shorter, it goes almost straight. That one winds round the hill, it is longer. Let's take the short one!

line.c_polana.text: Here we are! The short path got us here in no time. Look, here's a blanket and a basket. This is where we'll have our picnic!

line.b_wedrowka.text: Now lead my pawn with your finger along the shorter path, all the way to the blanket.

line.b_wedrowka_nie.text: Not that way, that's the long path round the hill! We're taking the shorter one.

line.b_wedrowka_tak.text: The short path goes straight to the blanket. Let's go!

line.c_kosz.text: My tummy is rumbling! What's in the basket?

line.c_bagietki.text: Two baguettes, I laid them from one line. Point to the longer one, so there is enough for the three of us.

line.c_bagietki_nie.text: This one is shorter, it won't do for the three of us. Point to the longer baguette.

line.c_bagietki_tak.text: Yes, the long baguette! There's enough for everyone.

line.d_dziekuje.text: We're home! Fox, here's your long scarf back. It kept me warm.

line.d_jedna_linia.text: They hang from one rail, just like from one line. Now you can see at once which one is longer.

line.d_ktory.text: Fox's scarf is the longer one. Point to Fox's scarf.

line.d_ktory_nie.text: This one is shorter, it's mine. Point to the one that hangs lower.

line.k_przeciagnij.text: Drag each piece of pasta to the line.

line.k_ojej.text: Oh dear! My pasta isn't long at all. It only lay further out.

line.k_najdluzszy_tak.text: Yes! The spaghetti is the longest.

line.k_najkrotszy_tak.text: Yes! The tiny elbow is the shortest.

line.k_kolanko.text: And mine is tiny. Yummy too!

line.d_zabawa.text: Let's play once more! We lay the pasta from one line.

line.d_zabawa_widac.text: Mine is longer, and Squirrel's is shorter. You can see it at once!

line.k_do_garnka.text: Drag both pieces of pasta into the pot.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for the picnic together! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the snail from the race on the meadow. We got it on the way to the picnic, when we learnt what is long and what is short.

line.a_cieszymy_sie.text: I'm so happy. Let's go to the meadow.
